item.title: A "frozen" dictionary for Python
item.description:
📝 frozendict The idea is fairly straightforward: add frozendict as a new immutable type to the language's builtins module. Iteration over a frozendict works as expected; the type implements the collections. freeze() method that would essentially just change the type of a dict object to frozendict.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/SubscriberLink/1047238/25c270b077849dc0/

item.title: Meta shuts down global accounts linked to abortion advice and queer content
item.description:
📝 Campaigners have reported increasing restrictions on many abortion and reproductive health accounts by Meta apps including Facebook and Instagram, but Meta denied any censorship.
